topic: Sensor firmware and antenna status for JCD
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the firmware and sensor models for JCD. Initially, it was noted that the last firmware update was in 2021, with a model of Rut 240 sensors and Panorama antennas.

It was confirmed that JCD did not approve certain updates, leading to the use of older firmware. However, one participant mentioned that all working sensors currently run version 53.7, which may have been installed by someone from headquarters across all devices in the JCD account.

Another participant noted that version 53.7 was approved at some point.
decisions: Current operational sensor firmware is version 53.7.
